Using the YDNA results from the [https://discover.familytreedna.com/groups/glasgow/tree?subgroups=52289,94891 Group Time Tree: Glasgow Surname] we get the following groups.

Group 2 is associated with the ancient haplogroup R-Z209 (2200BCE). This diverged from R-L151
into R-P312 around 4,800 years ago in Eurasia, as opposed to R-U106 for group 1. 

Personal match details, tester identifiers and private information are omitted from this public edition; the historical research and source references are retained.
Given the other Glasscock YDNA testers in this group and the tendency for Glasscock's to [https://archive.ph/OZSgC drop the 'ck'], the similarity here with the Glasgow surname is likely coincidental.
